moments.text: Blue-tinted daylight view looking down on a city, crosshair at centre. A small white round spot sits just left of the crosshair.
The view switches to grey infrared over open ground; hot vehicles show white. No spot stands out near the crosshair.
The picture flashes white and black as the view zooms in.
Zoomed in on grey ground, a small dark dot right of the crosshair moves right and leaves the right edge.
More black and white flashes, then the wide infrared view returns.
The infrared view pans over a dark river channel, fields and buildings; no spot is clearly visible.
Back in the blue-tinted daylight view over the city, the small white round spot shows near the crosshair, drifting around it.
The white spot passes over a stretch of dark water, left of the crosshair, where it is easiest to see.
The view pans over buildings and a sports track; the white spot drifts toward the lower left of the frame.

notes: Object is only clearly visible in the blue daylight mode; in grey IR mode only during the 17.3-18.6 s zoom.
